description: interior_control_up on a chain running down -X with the joints' +X pointing back. The interior control moves 2 up, so the curve is the x-mirror of the +X case: it passes through (0,0,0), (-4,2,0) and (-8,0,0) with every tangent (-8,0,0). The joints at u = 0.25 and 0.75 are at (-2,1,0) and (-6,1,0), where the slope is (-8,6,0) and then (-8,-6,0). A joint's rest forward direction is (-1,0,0) at 180 degrees. (-8,6) is at 143.1301 degrees, so tail2 turns -36.8699 about Z, and (-8,-6) is at 216.8699 degrees, so tail4 turns +36.8699. At the control the slope is the tangent, so no turn.
